sourceItems.title: 山东清理违规电解铝产能321万吨 电解铝供需拐点将现
normalizedClaims: Shandong ordered 3.21m tonnes of illegal electrolytic-aluminum capacity shut, close to 8% of nationwide operating capacity cited in the report.
The market had already reacted strongly: SHFE aluminum rose more than 11% from Aug-1 to Aug-10.
The policy mechanism was real capacity removal, but the price response was already substantial.
observedChanges: large-scale policy-driven aluminum capacity removal becomes concrete while prices already rerate

sourceItems.title: 电解铝库存出现下降
normalizedClaims: Seven-market aluminum inventory was 1.609m tonnes, down 32kt from Sep-8 and the first decline in about two months.
Inventory had remained unusually high and continued rising beforehand, creating doubt about whether supply-side reform was tightening the market quickly enough.
The report cited cumulative production cuts of about 3.459m tonnes by Sep-7, so capacity contraction and high inventory coexisted.
observedChanges: upstream capacity is contracting but downstream inventory remains high, creating a state-flow conflict

sourceItems.title: 稀土报价大幅上调 钨价有望持续上涨
normalizedClaims: Many rare-earth quotations rose sharply in early August; praseodymium-neodymium products had risen close to 60% year-to-date.
Contemporaneous commentary attributed tighter supply partly to crackdowns on illegal rare-earth activity and environmental inspections in major producing regions.
observedChanges: rare-earth supply discipline and enforcement coincide with a sharp price rally

sourceItems.title: 行情逆转！中重稀土价格全面下跌，南方稀土联盟倡议停产挺价
normalizedClaims: From late August into late September, rare-earth prices reversed from the earlier surge into broad declines.
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide was reported around RMB460k/t on Sep-28, about 19.5% below its prior high.
Industry participants described downstream resistance to the earlier rapid price increase, while a southern rare-earth alliance proposed a one-month shutdown to stabilize prices.
observedChanges: a previously strong supply-tightness narrative is contradicted by demand resistance and a late-quarter price reversal

sourceItems.title: New energy vehicles kept rapid growth on yearly basis
normalizedClaims: August NEV production reached about 72k units and sales about 68k, up 67.3% and 76.3% YoY respectively.
Battery-electric vehicle sales were about 56k, up 95.5% YoY.
observedChanges: NEV end-demand accelerates sharply into late Q3

sourceItems.title: 碳酸锂价格继续上涨 上市公司密集扩产能
normalizedClaims: Battery-grade lithium carbonate prices rose again in mid-September and had gained about 15.7% over the prior three months.
Contemporaneous analysis attributed the move to supply-demand imbalance: growing NEV/battery demand while near-term upstream supply expansion was constrained.
Multiple producers were simultaneously announcing capacity expansion, creating an eventual supply-response risk.
observedChanges: lithium demand and price are rising, but industry expansion creates a future normalization path

sourceItems.title: 金九银十 销量暴增 三一挖机再掀全国疯抢热潮！
sourceItems.publisher: 中国路面机械网代理商平台
normalizedClaims: August excavator sales were 8,714 units, +99.5% YoY; domestic sales were +106.1% and exports +49.6%.
The report attributed the boom to infrastructure, exports and replacement demand.
observedChanges: construction-machinery physical demand remains extremely strong through the traditional summer off-season

sourceItems.title: 国家能源局关于推进光伏发电“领跑者”计划实施和2017年领跑基地建设有关要求的通知 国能发新能[2017]54号
normalizedClaims: 2017 application-leader bases required module efficiency of at least 17% for multicrystalline and 17.8% for monocrystalline products.
Technology-leader bases required at least 18% multicrystalline and 18.9% monocrystalline module efficiency.
Application-base bidding required a proposed tariff at least 10% below the local benchmark tariff, simultaneously rewarding higher technology and increasing price pressure.
The program explicitly aimed to accelerate technology progress, remove lagging capacity and reduce costs/subsidy dependence.
observedChanges: policy simultaneously raises technology thresholds and compresses project tariffs, favoring differentiated high-efficiency manufacturers over generic PV beta

sourceItems.title: DRAM Industry Analysis－3Q17
normalizedClaims: TrendForce reported Q2 global DRAM revenue up 16.9% QoQ as ASPs rose and supplier technology migrations progressed.
The Q3 market remained supported by strong pricing and tight supply.
observedChanges: DRAM tightness is already converting into higher supplier revenue and prices

sourceItems.title: Server DIMM Price Sep. 2017
normalizedClaims: September server-DRAM contract prices remained elevated as demand continued to strain supply.
The product-state signal remained positive at quarter-end, but it was already visible in contract pricing.
observedChanges: memory scarcity remains real but downstream pricing already confirms the state

eventClusters.statement: Electrolytic-aluminum illegal capacity was being shut at material scale, but inventories remained historically high even as prices had already rerated sharply, creating a capacity-state versus inventory/price-flow conflict.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Capacity removal is concrete, but high inventory and an already-strong commodity-price response can delay or fully absorb the earnings benefit; company compliance/cost/geography may matter more than broad aluminum beta.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Before declaring a broad aluminum opportunity or No selection, can company-level compliance, power cost, legal capacity and product mix identify a materially different earnings path?

eventClusters.statement: Rare-earth prices surged on enforcement/supply-discipline expectations, then reversed sharply by late September as downstream users resisted earlier price increases and producers considered fresh shutdowns to stabilize the market.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Supply discipline is real, but the late-quarter price reversal demonstrates demand elasticity and speculative inventory risk; current high prices cannot be treated as a monotonic bullish signal.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a listed company with a different cost/product/contract exposure that can sustain earnings through the price reversal, or should the sector remain Research/No selection?

eventClusters.statement: China NEV sales accelerated sharply in August while battery-grade lithium carbonate prices continued rising on near-term supply constraints, although producers were also announcing expansion.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Demand and price are both strong, but the commodity may already be highly absorbed and announced expansion creates a future normalization risk.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can a listed lithium/battery-material company show underreflected realized earnings or cost/resource advantage after accounting for commodity-price absorption and expansion risk?

eventClusters.statement: Excavator demand remained exceptionally strong through August, with industry sales roughly doubling year on year despite the seasonal off-season.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The boom is real but increasingly well known after months of triple-digit growth; company cash conversion, receivables, debt and valuation must determine whether any residual opportunity remains.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any machinery leader still have a company-specific earnings/quality gap after the sector boom has become consensus?

eventClusters.statement: The 2017 PV Leader program simultaneously raised module-efficiency thresholds and required aggressive tariff competition, explicitly accelerating advanced-technology adoption while pressuring generic project economics.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Sector-level effect is intrinsically mixed: lower tariffs pressure projects and commodity-like capacity, while stricter efficiency thresholds may create company exceptions among technology/cost leaders.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does a listed manufacturer have cutoff-valid technology, cost and capacity evidence showing a different earnings path from the conflicted aggregate PV sector?

eventClusters.statement: Global DRAM tightness continued through Q3 and was already visible in rising supplier revenue and server contract prices at quarter-end.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Product economics are strong but already confirmed by price/revenue; A-share mapping must not substitute generic semiconductor names for direct DRAM supplier earnings.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a direct A-share expression with current DRAM earnings conversion and residual expectation room, or should mapping fail closed?
